text: rc 3 from a hover: the broker maps any nonzero hover exit to INPUT_UNCERTAIN, which freezes the queue in RECONCILE. With --expect-change none, vision returns rc 3 on any unmasked visible change, so a hover highlight in Blender would freeze the queue.
anchor: `vision` returns rc 3 on any unmasked visible change

text: rc 3 is ambiguous in wait-event: NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE (an executed act) maps to the same rc 3 as STALE_FRAME (a requeued refusal). Read the receipt code, not the exit code alone; re-enqueueing on rc 3 would repeat an executed act blindly.
anchor: maps `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE` to the same rc 3 as `STALE_FRAME`

text: Run the MCP server as `VP_MCP_SESSION=/abs/path/to/session.json /usr/bin/python3 -I vp_mcp.py`. It is a stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server named viewpoint-agent, version 0.2.0.
vp_mcp never uses native input or capture on app-owned capsules. Input goes only through mvctl observe/propose/wait-verify or mw_run, and the only native verb is the read-only `srf ax`.
anchor: Native input/capture calls on app-owned capsules bypass core admission and

text: vp_list_capsules takes no arguments. It pages through `mvctl list --limit 256` (up to 16 pages) and maps each configured identity to its active browser surface (surface_id/kind/state). It returns no title or URL.

F1 ref_broker runs turns with `VP_SWARM_NONCE=$N python3 broker.py run --job vpref1 --rt $RT --turns 12` (rc 0 idle, 3 RECONCILE/FROZEN, 2 error); leave RECONCILE with `python3 broker.py control --rt $RT --op resume --by director-agent --reason "..."`.

F1 claims live in `RT/claims.json` and agents write `RT/intents/<agent_id>/<event_id>.json` (tmp + rename); the broker is the only writer of `RT/events.jsonl`, `RT/cursor.jsonl`, `RT/frames/` and the only caller of `vision look/act`.
The broker reads the nonce from env `VP_SWARM_NONCE` only (never from RT, which agents can read), and `run` rebuilds state from `events.jsonl` so it can be called repeatedly.
anchor: The broker reads the nonce from env `VP_SWARM_NONCE` only

text: `STALE_FRAME`: a gui `based_on_frame` older than the head frame with differing pixels in between goes to the tail with `drops+1`; the agent may resubmit the same `event_id` citing a newer frame (`rebased:true`); 3 drops park it.
`INPUT_UNCERTAIN` (hover/key returned an rc other than 0/3, e.g. 8 or 9) and `OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN` close the event and put the queue in RECONCILE, with no dispatch and no repeat until `control resume`.
Outbox line 1 is `OK`/`ERROR` and `META` carries `mac` = HMAC-SHA256(nonce, event_id, status, script sha); the broker requires the mac, so an agent cannot answer for the bridge.
anchor: The broker requires the mac, so an agent cannot answer for the bridge.

text: The Gemini H1 broker runs live with `python3 -m swarm.broker.broker --job vpswarm --vision-mode live`, or offline with `--vision-mode mock --drain-and-exit` and `/tmp/swarm_dryrun` paths.

Gemini contract: the broker writes jobs `<nonce>__<seq>__<event_id>.py` atomically into `SWARM_INBOX`, the bridge answers `<nonce>__<seq>__<event_id>.json` receipts with status `OK`|`ERROR`, and other inbox files are moved to `SWARM_REJECTED` unexecuted.

Gemini lease rule: for `lane: "script"` `write_set` must be non-empty and every element must start with one of the claim's `write_prefixes`, otherwise `CLAIM_REFUSED`; stale `lease_epoch` or late arrival is `LEASE_EXPIRED`, a missing lease `NO_LEASE`.
F2 records with `PID=$(./record.sh :99 take1 /path/outdir)` (writes `outdir/take1_<HHMM>.mp4` plus `.start_ms` and `.log` sidecars) and stops with `kill -INT "$PID"`.
Stop the recorder with SIGINT only, by PID: `kill -INT` lets ffmpeg finalise the mp4, `kill -9` leaves it unplayable.

Compose overlays with `python3 compose.py --video outdir/take1_1133.mp4 --out outdir/take1_overlay.mp4 --rt /dev/shm/vqa-cu/ref --start-file outdir/take1_1133.start_ms`; it prints one JSON summary line; display `:1` is refused (rc 3) and an existing output is never overwritten (rc 4).

Gemini `swarm/tools/record.sh` unconditionally exits 2 on `:1` (also `:01`, `:001`, `:1.0`, even with `--allow-display0`) and refuses `:0` unless `--allow-display0`; the compositor renders off-display only.

F3 projects broker events once with `python3 product/ref_projection/project.py --once --osb-room viewpoint-capsule --tasklight-room viewpoint` (omit `--once` to follow; SIGTERM/SIGINT or `--idle-exit S` finalizes).
`reconcile.py --events $RT/events.jsonl --ledger $RT/projection/ledger.jsonl` flags `MISSING_CLOSE_TASK` or `NO_PLAN` agents: rc 0 clean, 1 flagged, 2 bad input.

project.py room defaults are the test rooms (`viewpoint-capsule-test`, `demo`), so pass `--osb-room`/`--tasklight-room` for the real rooms; it writes only `RT/projection/state.json` and `RT/projection/ledger.jsonl`.
anchor: Defaults for the rooms are the test rooms

text: A truncated or replaced `events.jsonl` (first-line sha256 kept in the state) is refused by the projector with exit 3: use a fresh `--out`.
anchor: is refused with exit 3: use a fresh `--out`.

text: Gemini contract: a refusal or park `close` projects as osb `refute` that must carry `--ref <event_id>` (osb rejects `refute` without `--ref` or `--evidence`, rc 2); `enqueue` maps to `claim`, a granted `turn` to `ack`.

Gemini reconciler: `INPUT_UNCERTAIN`/`OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN` events are cleared only by an explicit `control op="reconcile"`; `control op="resume"` does not clear them and unreconciled ones are flagged `UNRECONCILED_UNCERTAIN_EVENT`.
anchor: `control op="resume"` does not clear uncertain events

text: F4 runs a stub team (no model) with `python3 runner.py run --rt $RT --evidence evidence/stub1 --stub --init-rt` inside the memory scope; it needs at least one frame in RT/frames.

The real-agent command puts `-p "<brief>"` last: `~/.local/bin/shims/agy --model gemini-4-hydrogen-high --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json --print-timeout 1800s --add-dir <RT> --log-file <evidence>/<agent>/agy_cli.log -p "<brief>"`.

Validate intents with `python3 contract.py --rt $RT [--agent modeler-agent] [--json]`: exit 0 = all valid, 1 = some invalid; `runner.py status|stop --evidence evidence/run1` inspects or stops by recorded PID.
anchor: validate whatever is in RT/intents (exit 0 = all valid, 1 = some invalid)

text: Gemini `intent_cli.py` (`observe`, `enqueue-script`, `enqueue-gui`, `wait-event`) returns from `wait-event` 0 verified, 2 `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`, 3 `STALE_FRAME` parked, 4 `DUPLICATE_EVENT`/`QUEUE_FULL`, 124 CLI timeout, 1 hard error.

Only the broker invokes `vision look/act --job vpswarm`; agents must read `/dev/shm/vqa-cu/swarm/frames/` read-only, never invoke `vision`, and write intents only inside their own `intents/<agent_id>/` via `.tmp` + rename.
R4 drives the rewindable capsule with `VP_SWARM_NONCE=<nonce> rewindctl.py run --job J --rt RT --turns N` (rc 0 idle, 3 FROZEN/RECONCILE); `mark` takes a director checkpoint.
Leave FROZEN with `VP_SWARM_NONCE=<nonce> rewindctl.py rewind --job J --rt RT --to last_good [--resume]`.
`rewindctl.py audit --rt RT | --events F` replays events.jsonl: rc 0 clean, 1 violations, 2 unreadable; `status`, `audit` and `emit-script` never touch Blender, vision or the nonce.
`scene_epoch` starts at 1, +1 per `control rewind`, never decreases; after a bump every queued gui intent closes `STALE_FRAME`.
anchor: After a bump every queued gui intent closes `STALE_FRAME`.

text: `FROZEN` is left only by `rewind(to=last_good, by="director")` followed by `control resume`; `resume` alone, a rewind to another point, or `by` other than `director` raise `BrokerError`; attempts are capped at `K_MAX = 3` per event id.
`load_ui=True` on `restore_script` is required for a camera GUI turn to be inside the rollback domain; call `st.verify(point)` (CKPT_CORRUPT / CKPT_MISSING) before every restore.
anchor: `load_ui=True` is required for a camera GUI turn

text: `python3 -I validate.py specs/blender_4agents.json` checks 13 rules (exit 0 green, 1 red, 2 unreadable; `--json`, `--skip RULE`); `render.py` only prints the launch plan for a GREEN spec and cannot execute.
anchor: 13 rules over a spec; exit 0 green, 1 red, 2 unreadable

text: Rule A-01: the broker mounts all of RT rw, the program only `inbox` and `outbox`, and an agent only its own `intents/<agent_id>` rw plus four read-only views, so `events.jsonl` has one writer.
anchor: an agent only its own `intents/<agent_id>` rw plus four read-only views

text: A `systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G` wrapped around `docker run` limits the docker client process, not the container; per-container flags are the limits that apply.
anchor: wrapped around `docker run` limits the docker

text: The auction scheduler only proposes: `pick = scheduler.pick(view)` then `recs = scheduler.settle(pick, close)`; the broker's `admit()` remains the only authority.
anchor: the broker's admit() remains the only authority

text: Bids are sidecars `RT/bids/<agent_id>/<event_id>.json` `{v,rec:"bid",agent_id,event_id,bid}`; missing or malformed = 0, and `bid_eff = min(bid, balance, bid_cap)`.
ref_auction is NOT wired into the live broker: the frozen H1 round-robin rule stays until a rehearsal A/B says otherwise; `broker_hook.patch` is not applied by the unit.
anchor: It is NOT wired into the live broker
